newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq shares end flat, tech stocks luke warm.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq shares end flat, tech stocks luke warm.

text.p: Nasdaq shares were flat amid a lackluster performance by technology stocks, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite index eased only 0.04 points to close unofficially at 1447.10, almost on par with Thursday's record high. Advancing issues outpaced decliners on a ratio of 11 to 10 with a total of 618 million shares. Nasdaq shares have showed gains in eight of the previous 10 sessions.
The Russell 2000 index, a key barometer of small capitalization stocks, lost 2.88 points from its record high to close at 393.61.

"The Nasdaq has managed to hold firm even though some of the big techs, like Intel and Microsoft, have been pretty tame. We had a record close yesterday, so it's positive that they didn't lose ground today, even though there wasn't any strong cue from the major techs," one trader said.
Intel Corp gained 5/16 to 146-3/4 and Microsoft Corp 9/16 to 129-7/8, while Oracle Corp slipped 1-5/16 to 48-1/4.

Shares of Great Plains Software Inc more than doubled in value in their first day of trading, gaining 16-3/8 to 32-3/8. Great Plains provides Microsoft Windows NT client/server financial management software for businesses.
